effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Angel] or [Archangel] trait and 1 card with the [Three Great Angels] trait among them to your hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Three Great Angels] trait, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
